Photo 1 and 2 show the same engine from different angles. The top cover has 'DOHC 16V VALVE' and a Mazda logo clearly visible. The engine is dusty and shows signs of use.
No visible model number or VIN plate is readable in any photo.
The engine appears to be a complete unit with all major components visible, including alternator, sensors, and wiring harnesses.
The seller claims it is for a Mazda 3, but no model-specific details are visible to confirm compatibility.
